verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud data warehouse and its bq CLI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for BigQuery or its tools. The IAM, compliance and cost-quota items are adjacent controls and do not address telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
